gloss: (of eyes) big and bright; wide open

definitions.gloss: big and bright; wide open (of eyes)
definitions.explanation: Of eyes: large, clear and attractive, or fully and brightly open, as when one is wide awake.

examples.japanese: ぱっちり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧。
⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぱっちり⟦{覚|さ}めた→覚める：02058_sameru⟧。

⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦お{昼寝|ひるね}→お昼寝：25469_ohirune⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{起|お}きて→起きる：00521_okiru⟧、⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぱっちり⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: The baby has woken from her nap and is looking at us with her eyes wide open.

notes:
A mimetic word used almost only of eyes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ぱっちり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: big, bright eyes
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぱっちり⟦{覚|さ}める→覚める：02058_sameru⟧: to wake up fully
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぱっちり⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open one's eyes wide
- ぱっちり⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧: big eyes with double eyelids

SIMILAR WORDS:
- くりくり: round and lively (of eyes), with a cute, childlike nuance
